description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Messages class, which manages a collection of message hashes with types such as debug, info, warn, and error. It provides methods to add messages, clear the message list, retrieve all messages, and iterate through messages.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Messages
classes.description: A class for managing a list of messages with different severity types, supporting addition, retrieval, and iteration.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and returns a new Messages object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a message to the collection. Accepts a hash reference, a string, or a list of key-value pairs. Validates message type and required fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all messages from the collection.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of all messages.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next message in the collection, removing it from the list.
